detail: October week-window searches and regional queries produced mostly Bissau leads; no verified eligible public event was identified. This is bounded search coverage, not evidence of no protests. The State Department page was opened once after local assessment but rendered a target-specific forbidden/technical page with no body; do not retry. No native access HTTP status was exposed.

Observed October leads were a press conference and an online petition. Crowd count/actual street-gathering coverage in Gabú, Bafatá, Cacheu, Tombali and other regions remains incomplete; queries in Portuguese/English/French did not yield a body-read regional protest report.

The existing per-target written prebody assessments predate body opens, but the helper-generated access-check workflow receipt was not captured for the October body attempts. These records are preserved for review; no post-open check can retroactively resolve that process gap.
